headline: Anil Agarwal files SEBI takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Anil Agarwal has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code Regulation 31(4), triggering mandatory reporting of shareholding movement in STL Networks Limited.
detail: Anil Agarwal has submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to NSE, signalling a substantial acquisition or further acquisition in STL Networks Limited. The regulation mandates disclosure within two working days of crossing key shareholding thresholds. The formal disclosure notice has been filed but the underlying transaction terms (price, quantum, conditions) are not disclosed in this notice itself.
